title: Solar reaches new power generation highs in Portugal in August
content:
Solar power generation in Portugal reached a record 3.85 GW in August, supported by continued growth in installed PV capacity. Renewables supplied 52% of electricity consumption during the month, while net imports accounted for 36%.

title: Scientists turn end-of-life PV silicon into high-value silicon nitride
content:
South Korean researchers have developed a method to upcycle silicon recovered from end-of-life PV modules into high-value silicon nitride (Si₃N₄). The process achieved recycled silicon purity of 99.95% through optimized milling, acid etching, and sedimentation before nitridation.

title: Chinese researchers build 27.39%-efficient inverted perovskite solar cell based on new molecular design
content:
Chinese researchers have developed a molecular additive that reduces defects in perovskite solar cells, enabling a power conversion efficiency of 27.39%. The approach was also used in bifacial mini-modules with efficiencies above 22% and 99.6% power retention after more than 5,000 hours of continuous operation.

title: A closer look at Fred. Olsen 1848’s load-decoupled modular floating PV system for nearshore applications
content:

title: South Korea posts fifth-highest power demand on record
content:
South Korea's market electricity demand reached 95.3 GW on Aug. 7, the fifth-highest level on record, as the government said combined market and behind-the-meter solar generation met about one-quarter of total daytime demand during the heat wave.

title: AI-powered drone system for autonomous PV fault detection
content:
An international research team has developed an autonomous drone-based system that combines thermal and multispectral imaging with AI to detect anomalies in PV installations. Tests showed that the best-performing AI model could reliably identify hotspots and surface contamination, although dust remained the most challenging defect to detect.

title: The Obama Foundation signs on as anchor tenant to Reactivate’s Illinois community solar installations

title: This new anti-theft device can keep your e-bike protected for up to a year straight
content: E-bike theft is one of those problems where a good lock is only half the battle. Since no physical lock can ever give you a 100% guarantee of safety, if a thief actually gets away with your bike, knowing where it went can suddenly become a lot more important.
